# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tool-reference.js. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

The MCP server exposes 16 tools over stdio. Start it with `npx -y ui-ux-suite --mcp`.
Every tool is read-only over your source.
No tool calls the network, with one exception: `uiux_audit_run` in deep mode opens the `baseUrl` you pass.

## Which tool do I use?

| Tool | Use it when |
| --- | --- |
| [`uiux_audit_run`](#uiux_audit_run) | You want the whole audit in one call. Start here. |
| [`uiux_scan_project`](#uiux_scan_project) | You only need to know the stack: framework, styling, component library, theme. |
| [`uiux_extract_colors`](#uiux_extract_colors) | You want every color in the project, with where it is used. |
| [`uiux_extract_typography`](#uiux_extract_typography) | You want the fonts, sizes, weights and line heights in use. |
| [`uiux_extract_spacing`](#uiux_extract_spacing) | You want the padding, margin and gap values in use. |
| [`uiux_check_contrast`](#uiux_check_contrast) | You have a foreground and a background color and want the WCAG and APCA numbers. |
| [`uiux_score_dimension`](#uiux_score_dimension) | You gathered data for one dimension yourself and want its score. |
| [`uiux_score_overall`](#uiux_score_overall) | You have per-dimension scores and want the weighted total. |
| [`uiux_generate_palette`](#uiux_generate_palette) | You have a brand color and need a full palette, dark mode included. |
| [`uiux_generate_type_scale`](#uiux_generate_type_scale) | You need a type scale from a base size and a ratio. |
| [`uiux_generate_spacing_scale`](#uiux_generate_spacing_scale) | You need a spacing scale from a base unit. |
| [`uiux_generate_tokens`](#uiux_generate_tokens) | You need a complete token set: color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion. |
| [`uiux_knowledge_query`](#uiux_knowledge_query) | You want the reasoning behind a rule, from the bundled knowledge files. |
| [`uiux_laws_query`](#uiux_laws_query) | You want the definition and source of a named UX law. |
| [`uiux_audit_log`](#uiux_audit_log) | An agent found something by reading code and wants to record it. |
| [`uiux_audit_report`](#uiux_audit_report) | You want the findings recorded with uiux_audit_log as one report. |

## Tools

### uiux_audit_run

Run a full 12-dimension design audit on a project. Single entry point: chains scan -> extract -> score -> report. Returns structured JSON with per-dimension scores, top findings, and a formatted markdown report that opens with the score and the three fixes to start with. This is the canonical way to audit a project in one call.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectPath` | string | no | Root path of the project to audit. Defaults to process.cwd(). |
| `baseUrl` | string | no | URL of the running app, used by deep mode only: live contrast and axe-core scanning through Playwright. Needs the optional peer deps playwright-core and @axe-core/playwright. |
| `depth` | `quick` or `deep` | no | quick = static analysis only (zero-dep default); deep = additionally launches Playwright + axe-core if peer deps are installed. |
| `dimensions` | array of string | no | Optional subset of the 12 dimensions to score. Omit to score all. |
| `format` | `full` or `summary` or `json` | no | full = JSON + markdown + findings; summary = scorecard + top findings; json = structured only. |

### uiux_scan_project

Scan project files and build a design profile: framework, styling approach, component library, theme system, design maturity.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectPath` | string | yes | Root path of the project to scan |

### uiux_extract_colors

Extract all color values from project CSS, Tailwind config, token files, and component styles.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectPath` | string | yes | Root path of the project |

### uiux_extract_typography

Extract all typography values: fonts, sizes, weights, line heights, letter spacing.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectPath` | string | yes | Root path of the project |

### uiux_extract_spacing

Extract all spacing values: padding, margin, gap from project styles.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectPath` | string | yes | Root path of the project |

### uiux_check_contrast

Check contrast ratios for foreground/background color pairs. Returns WCAG and APCA scores.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pairs` | array of object | yes | Array of color pairs to check |

### uiux_score_dimension

Score a specific design dimension (1-10) with findings.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dimension` | `color` or `typography` or `layout` or `components` or `accessibility` or `hierarchy` or `interaction` or `responsive` or `polish` or `performance` or `flows` or `platform` | yes | Which dimension to score |
| `data` | object | yes | Extracted data for this dimension |

### uiux_score_overall

Calculate overall weighted design score from dimension scores.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scores` | object | yes | Object mapping dimension IDs to scores (1-10) |

### uiux_generate_palette

Generate a color palette from a base/brand color with semantic roles, surfaces, and dark mode.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brandColor` | string | yes | Primary brand color (hex) |
| `style` | `warm` or `cool` or `neutral` | no | Neutral palette temperature |
| `includeDarkMode` | boolean | no | Generate dark mode palette too |

### uiux_generate_type_scale

Generate a type scale from base size and ratio.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseSize` | number | no | Base font size in px (default 16) |
| `ratio` | `minor-second` or `major-second` or `minor-third` or `major-third` or `perfect-fourth` or `augmented-fourth` or `perfect-fifth` or `golden-ratio` | no | Scale ratio name |
| `fluid` | boolean | no | Generate fluid clamp() values |

### uiux_generate_spacing_scale

Generate a spacing scale from a base unit.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUnit` | number | no | Base spacing unit in px (default 4) |
| `steps` | number | no | Number of steps (default 16) |

### uiux_generate_tokens

Generate a complete design token set: color, typography, spacing, border-radius, shadows, motion.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brandColor` | string | yes | Primary brand color (hex) |
| `style` | `neo-minimal` or `soft-material` or `editorial` or `glass-depth` or `dark-luxury` or `warm-organic` or `dense-functional` or `bold-expressive` or `calm-tech` or `system-native` | no | Visual style direction |
| `format` | `css-vars` or `tailwind` or `json` or `js` | no | Output format |

### uiux_knowledge_query

Query the design knowledge base. Searches both the structured knowledge object and 21 markdown knowledge documents.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `color` or `typography` or `components` or `accessibility` or `layout` or `interaction` or `styleDirections` | no | Knowledge category (structured data) |
| `key` | string | no | Dot-separated key path (e.g., "harmony.complementary") |
| `search` | string | no | Free-text search across all knowledge (structured + markdown files) |
| `file` | string | no | Load a specific knowledge file by name (e.g., "color-theory" or "evidence-base") |
| `listFiles` | boolean | no | List all available knowledge files with descriptions |

### uiux_laws_query

Query the Laws of UX knowledge base. Returns entries for Hicks Law, Fittss Law, Millers Law, Jakobs Law, Doherty Threshold, Peak-End Rule, Gestalt laws, and 18 others. Filters (all optional) compose with AND semantics.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | no | Match by law slug (e.g., "hicks-law") or substring of the law name |
| `dimension` | `color` or `typography` or `layout` or `components` or `accessibility` or `hierarchy` or `interaction` or `responsive` or `polish` or `performance` or `flows` or `platform` | no | Filter laws that tag this scoring dimension |
| `surface` | string | no | Filter by surface tag: navigation, forms, content, motion, timing, layout, copy, media, data-display, onboarding |
| `cognitiveProcess` | `perception` or `attention` or `memory` or `decision-making` or `motor` or `emotion` | no | Filter by cognitive process tag |

### uiux_audit_log

Append a finding to the current audit log.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dimension` | string | yes | Design dimension |
| `severity` | `critical` or `important` or `suggestion` or `nice-to-have` | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string | yes |  |
| `impact` | string | no |  |
| `fix` | string | no |  |
| `effort` | `trivial` or `small` or `medium` or `large` or `major` | no |  |
| `before` | string | no | Current code/state |
| `after` | string | no | Recommended code/state |
| `laws` | array of string | no | Slugs of UX laws this finding cites (e.g., ["hicks-law", "choice-overload"]) |

### uiux_audit_report

Generate a formatted markdown audit report from the current audit log.

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `full` or `summary` or `scorecard` | no | Report format |
